main.description: Add an MCP server to the org. Nobody signs in to it yet: for an oauth server pear discovers its authorization server and registers itself as a client, by dynamic client registration unless clientId is given, and each member then connects with startAuthorization; a manual server needs no auth, so every member is connected to it automatically. Either give preset, or give url and authType (and optionally clientId and clientSecret). Requires service-auth. Requires the mcp.configure action.

org.description: DID of the community to add the server to.

name.description: Also becomes the server's ID and the namespace under which its tools are exposed. Letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores only, and must be unique within the org.

preset.description: A known connector to add. pear fills in its URL and auth type and uses the OAuth client it holds for the connector, shared by all orgs, so url, authType, clientId and clientSecret must be omitted. Fails if pear has no client configured for the connector.

url.description: The server's streamable HTTP endpoint. Required unless preset is given, in which case it must be omitted.

authType.description: How pear authenticates to the server; see network.habitat.mcp.defs#server. Required unless preset is given, in which case it must be omitted.

clientId.description: oauth servers only: the ID of an OAuth client pre-registered with the server's authorization server, for servers that don't support dynamic client registration. Its redirect URI must be pear's MCP OAuth callback.

clientSecret.description: oauth servers only: the pre-registered client's secret, if it has one. Stored encrypted and never returned.
